query: Which material can be used for enhanced catalytic activity and durability toward HER and HOR, and why?

generation.hypothesis: A transition metal alloyed catalyst, specifically a nickel-molybdenum (Ni-Mo) alloy, will exhibit enhanced catalytic activity and durability toward the Hydrogen Evolution Reaction (HER) and Hydrogen Oxidation Reaction (HOR) due to the modified electronic and geometric properties resulting from the alloying process.
generation.material_initial_state: Ni-Mo alloy in its initial, untested state
generation.intervention: Transition metal alloying with molybdenum (Mo) content varying from 0 to 50 atomic percent
generation.conditions: Electrochemical conditions, with the electrolyte being 0.5 M sulfuric acid (H2SO4) and the temperature maintained at 25°C
generation.structural_mediator: The modified electronic structure and surface geometry of the Ni-Mo alloy catalyst
generation.mechanism: The alloying of nickel with molybdenum leads to a synergistic effect, enhancing the catalyst's ability to adsorb and desorb hydrogen, thus facilitating both HER and HOR
generation.predicted_outcome: An increase in exchange current density (j0) by at least 20% and a decrease in Tafel slope by at least 10% compared to pure nickel, indicating enhanced catalytic activity and durability
generation.baseline: Pure nickel catalyst under the same electrochemical conditions
generation.boundary: Mo content in the alloy exceeding 50 atomic percent, beyond which the catalytic activity may decrease due to the formation of less active phases
generation.uncertainty: The optimal composition of the Ni-Mo alloy and the exact mechanisms by which the alloying enhances catalytic activity and durability are subject to further investigation

falsification_experiment.design: Electrochemical half-cell setup with a rotating disk electrode (RDE) to measure the catalytic activity of the Ni-Mo alloy towards HER and HOR
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the measured exchange current density (j0) of the Ni-Mo alloy catalyst does not exceed that of pure nickel by at least 15% under the specified conditions, the hypothesis is falsified.

goal.reactions: Hydrogen Evolution Reaction (HER) and Hydrogen Oxidation Reaction (HOR)

frame.limitation: current materials have limited catalytic activity and durability
prior_attempts: reason for shortfall: limited activity and durability
